messages:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — planning to onboard opera-4b into the model catalog tomorrow 10:00 PT. Plan: pin opera-4b -> stable-v1, canary 5% for first 30m, then promote if smoke looks good. Smoke window 10:15-10:45 PT.
Samir Patel: thx maya. who is owning the smoke run and rollback?
Maya Chen: Derek will run smoke, Priya will be backup. ops-team is on standby for infra issues.
Derek O'Neill: I can take smoke. will run through the smoke checklist and confirm perf/regressions. can someone drop the exact pin command / runbook link? @Maya
Maya Chen: sure — runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-pinning (note: internal). Pin command for catalog API: 
```
curl -X POST https://catalog.redwood/api/v1/pin \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"opera-4b","alias":"stable-v1","variant":"fp16-qat","canary_percent":5,"owner":"eng-ml"}'
```
Derek O'Neill: perfect. I'll execute at 10:00 PT and start smoke at 10:15. Acceptance checks: sample-prompt coverage (promptset: onboard/opera-smoke), p99 latency <= 220ms on stable routes, sampler-based output-quality no regression >2% on eval.
Priya Nair: confirm rollback steps?
Maya Chen: rollback plan: revert alias to previous model (chorus3b-v2) and demote opera-4b. rollback command: 
```
# revert alias
curl -X POST https://catalog.redwood/api/v1/pin \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"chorus3b-v2","alias":"stable-v1","owner":"eng-ml"}'
```
Maya Chen: infra-bot already reserved the dedicated slot: `dedicated-pool-3` for the window. infra-bot: share capacity details?
infra-bot: reserved 3 x A6000 nodes on dedicated-pool-3 from 2026-05-12T09:45:00Z to 2026-05-12T12:00:00Z. Fallback region: us-west-2 with mixed-quant variants pinned.
Samir Patel: how do we handle quant variants for serving? do we pin fp16-qat or also a q4 variant for cost fallback?
Maya Chen: we'll pin fp16-qat to stable-v1 and also register a cost-fallback alias stable-v1-cost -> opera-4b-q4a. Smart routing will fall back if latency spikes or capacity low.
Derek O'Neill: noted. I'll run smoke test list and post initial results in this thread. if anything looks off i'll trigger rollback and ping ops-team.
Priya Nair: small ask — can someone add me to the runbook's oncall checklist scope? want to be notified by the smoke-runner step.
Maya Chen: done — added you. also added a short checklist: 1) verify model size + kv cache hits, 2) run 50 sample prompts, 3) check p99 and error rate, 4) toggle canary to 0/100 if promoting.
Derek O'Neill: starting pin at 167? (will post exact response) — ETA smoke report by 10:35 PT.
ops-team: :thumbsup: on standby.
Samir Patel: pinging infra PR that enables canary routing — @Derek can you confirm CI green before pin?
Derek O'Neill: yep CI is green on my branch (https://ci.redwood/changes/5482) — will double-check right before execute.
Maya Chen: thanks all. if no major flags we'll promote to 100% at ~10:45 PT. otherwise rollback and re-triage.
Derek O'Neill: update: pin completed, canary at 5%. running sample prompts now (posting results shortly).
